name: BAD-NeRF
aliases: Bundle Adjusted Deblur Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A method that jointly learns the parameters of a Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) and recovers camera motion trajectories during exposure time to handle severe motion blurred images and inaccurate camera poses.
summary: BAD-NeRF reconstructs 3D scenes from motion-blurred images by jointly optimizing NeRF parameters and camera trajectories, unlike methods relying on fixed poses.
